requirements.title: IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN reports NaN support for X kind
requirements.definition: IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(X) is true exactly for real kind type parameters for which the processor supports IEEE NaNs, and false for real kinds without that support.

pending.ieee-support-nan-kind-inquiry: Probe IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(x) for default and selected nondefault real variables; true branch performs the NaN-observable facet, false branch records an unsupported skip, and mutation inverts the recorded logical result.
pending.ieee-support-nan-true-branch-nan-observa: Probe concrete calls IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(1.5) and IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.5); true branch guarded by both invokes IEEE_VALUE(1.5,IEEE_QUIET_NAN) and IEEE_VALUE(1.5,IEEE_SIGNALING_NAN), with IEEE_CLASS and IEEE_IS_NAN observer invocations also covered by IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.5). Assert IEEE_CLASS reports IEEE_QUIET_NAN and IEEE_SIGNALING_NAN respectively plus IEEE_IS_NAN for both, and record payloads as unasserted. False branch records unsupported skip. Mutations swap the class constants or replace a NaN with 1.0.

requirements.title: IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN without X reports all-real NaN support
requirements.definition: IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN() is true exactly when IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(X) is true for all real X, and false otherwise.

pending.ieee-support-nan-no-x-all-real-relation: Generate scalar representatives for every available real kind from ISO_FORTRAN_ENV REAL_KINDS, statically instantiating each kind as REAL(0.0,kind); assert IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN() .EQV. ALL of the instantiated IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(REAL(0.0,kind)) results. This checks both directions: no-X true entails every X-form true, and all X-forms true entails no-X true. Mutation drops one kind-specific conjunct.
